name: qa-pilot
description: AI-driven web & app testing: user story -> test cases -> Playwright runs -> reports -> Jira

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
